description:
Upload an image or video to posterly storage and get a URL for create_post. Supports JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, MP4, MOV, WebM (PDFs are not accepted here: use create_signed_upload or create_media_drop). Images up to 10MB, videos up to 50MB. Three ways in: file_path (an explicit local path the user gave you), base64_data with filename (PREFERRED for images shared in chat, which are not on the local filesystem), or url (a public HTTPS image or video; local/private network URLs are blocked).

This writes to the user's media storage (counts against quota) but does NOT publish the file anywhere. Uploading is safe - it's the subsequent `create_post` call that publishes content, and that tool has its own confirmation requirements. Never guess file paths. You can also pass public HTTP(S) media URLs directly to create_post/update_post; use url here when you want to upload once and reuse the returned posterly URL.

base64_data.description: Base64-encoded file data. PREFERRED for images shared directly in chat - extract the image data as base64 and pass it here.

content_type.description: MIME type (auto-detected from filename if omitted)

file_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path (e.g. /Users/name/photo.jpg). Only use when the user gives you an explicit path. Do NOT guess paths for images uploaded in chat.

filename.description: Filename with extension (e.g. photo.jpg, video.mp4). Required with file_path or base64_data; optional override with url.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL for the image or video to copy into posterly storage. Local/private network URLs are blocked.

workspace_id.description: Optional. The workspace this acts in and whose plan pays (from whoami). Needed only when your connection can act in several workspaces.

name: upload_media
